segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Good afternoon, Dream time Travel. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Oh hello. I'm interested in the holidays you otTer along the coast near here.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yes. We operate several tours up the coast. Where in particular did you want to go?

segments.speaker: CUSTOM ER
segments.en: Well, I like the sound of the holiday that mentioned whales. Was it 'Whale Watching'?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Oh, that's our Whale Watch Experience. It's very popular and it's based in a lovely little town with nice beaches.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Oh right, and how long does it last?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: It's two days - that includes four hours' travel time each way from here.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Good, I don't want to be away any longer than that. So is that by coach?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Actually it's by minibus. We like to keep those tours small and personal so we don't take a whole coachload of people. In fact, we only take up to fifteen people on this tour, although we do run it with just twelve or thirteen.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Oh, right. So do you run these tours often?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Well it depends on the time of year. Of course in peak times like the summer holidays we do them every weekend, but at the moment it's usually once a month at most.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: And when is the next one going?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Mmm, let me see. Urn, there's one in three weeks' time which is April the 18th, and then we don't have another one until June the 2nd.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: All right, and is April a good time to go?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Pretty good. Though the really good time is later in the year. I have to say though that the whale sighting is only one of the many things ofTered.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Really?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yes. The hotel itself where you stay has great facilities. It's called The Pallisades.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: The Paris what?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: No, it's actually The Pallisades, P-A-L-L-I-S-A-0-E-S. It's right on the main beach there.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Oh, I see.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: All of the rooms have nice views and the food is really good there too.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Oh right.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: And what about the other things? You know, that are included in the pnce.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Oh, there are lots of things. If you don't want to do the whale watch cruise, your guide will take anyone who is interested either on a bushwalk through the national park near the hotel, and there's no / extra charge for that, or on a fishing trip. That's an extra $12 I think. And there's also a reptile park in town - that costs more or less the same.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: No, I think I'd prefer whales to snakes.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yeah. And if you just want to relax you are free to sit by the hotel pool or go down the beach. Oh, and they also have tennis courts at the hotel, but you have to pay for those by the hour. But there are table tennis tables downstairs and they're part of the / accommodation package. Just speak to your guide.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Well that sounds good. So how much is the basic tour price?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: At this time of year it's usually around $300 but let me check. Er. .. oh, it's actually $280.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: And the next tour, are there any places on that one?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: How many people is it for?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: There are two of us.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yes, that should be fine. Can I just mention that we require all bookings to be made at least fourteen days before you travel to avoid cancellations of tours. And if you cancel within seven days of departure you will have to pay 50% of your total booking.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: And you also need to pay a 20% deposit at the time of booking.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Can I pay that by credit card?

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Yes, you can.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: All right, what I'll do is I'll talk to my partner and get back to you.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: Fine. So I'll make a provisional booking, shall I? - two for the Whale Watch Experience. Let me issue you with a customer reference number for when you call back. Do you have a pen?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
segments.en: OK, it's three nine seven. four five, T. That's T for tango. When you call back, ask to speak to the Tour Manager, that's me, Tracy.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Fine, I will.
